English Language.question: ১) The correct passive form of ''Someone built this building in 1987'' is-
English Language.option1: ক) This building is built in 1987.
English Language.option2: খ) This building was built in 1987.
English Language.option3: গ) This building has been built by someone in 1987.
English Language.option4: ঘ) This building was built by someone.
English Language.exp:
Active voice-এর বাক্যটাকে passive-এ আনতে যে structure ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে তা হল- active-এর objectকে subject-এ রূপান্তর+ modal auxiliary+be+verb-এর past participle form. যেহেতু সময় উল্লেখ করা ছিল, তাই, এখানে in 1987 কথাটি যুক্ত করা হয়েছে।
কিন্তু by someone কথাটি omit করা হয়েছে। passive structure-এ অনেক সময় by someone কথাটি বাদ দেয়া হয়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P C Das

English Language.question: ২) If someone says that he can’t stand it then it means-
English Language.exp:
Someone can’t stand someone/something (phrase)
Meaning: Used for saying that a person dislike someone or something very much.
Source: Macmillan Dictionary

English Language.question: ৩) Which is the correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) Several indicate that they will be late.
English Language.option2: খ) Several indicates that they will be late.
English Language.option3: গ) Several indications that they will be late.
English Language.option4: ঘ) Several is indicating that they will be late.
English Language.exp: এখানে subject হল Several এবং এটি plural. তাই, plural subject-এর number অনুযায়ী verb plural হয়।

English Language.question: ৪) The idiom 'That’s a bit steep.' means-
English Language.option4: ঘ) It is a bit different
English Language.exp:
Be a bit steep
Meaning: To be more expensive than was expected or is reasonable.
Example: Thirty bucks for two movie tickets and popcorn? That’s a bit steep, don’t you think?
Source: theidioms.freedictionary.com

English Language.question: ৫) Choose the correct sentence?
English Language.option1: ক) He is afraid from dogs.
English Language.option2: খ) He is afraid with dogs.
English Language.option3: গ) He is afraid to dogs.
English Language.option4: ঘ) He is afraid of dogs.
English Language.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থঃ সে কুকুর ভয় পায়।
Appropriate Preposition-এর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী, afraid-এর পরে of বসে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P C Das

English Language.question: ৬) Choose the meaning of the idiom - 'pull out all the stops'.
English Language.option1: ক) To challenge the enemy with courage
English Language.option2: খ) Force the enemy to submit
English Language.option3: গ) To make a big effort
English Language.exp:
To pull out all the stops
Meaning: To make a very great effort to achieve something
We pulled out all the stops to meet the deadline.
Source: Oxford Languages

English Language.question: ৭) Select the correctly spelt word :
English Language.exp:
Allegiance (NOUN):
Meaning: Loyalty or commitment to a superior or to a group or cause.
those wishing to receive a citizenship must swear allegiance to the republic.
Source: Oxford Languages

English Language.question: ৮) Which one in the correct indirect narration? I said to her, ''Could you please open that door for me?
English Language.option1: ক) I requested her to open the door for me.
English Language.option2: খ) She requested me to open the door for her.
English Language.option3: গ) She requested me to open the door for me.
English Language.option4: ঘ) I requested her to open the door for her.
English Language.exp:
Could, would দিয়ে শুরু হলে কিছু বাক্য interrogative form না হয়ে অর্থের দিক দিয়ে imperative, তাই এটি to দ্বারা reported speech-এর অংশটুকু যুক্ত করে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৯) Choose the correct sentence-
English Language.option1: ক) The doctor’s mistake proved to be fatal for the patients
English Language.option2: খ) The doctor’s mistake proved to be fatal to the patients.
English Language.option3: গ) The doctor’s mistake proved to be fatal with the patients .
English Language.option4: ঘ) The doctor’s mistake proved to be fatal on the patients.
English Language.exp:
Fatal (adjective):
Meaning: causing death
Bengali Meaning: মারাত্মক
কিসের প্রতি মারাত্মক সেটা বুঝালে fatal-এর পরে to বসে।
Source: Oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com

English Language.question: ১০) Choose the correct sentence-
English Language.option1: ক) Can you guess about her age?
English Language.option2: খ) Can you guess for her age?
English Language.option3: গ) Can you guess on her age?
English Language.option4: ঘ) Can you guess at her age?
English Language.exp:
অনুমান করা অর্থে বুঝালে guess-এর পরে at বসে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ১১) Choose the correct one-
English Language.exp:
Definitely (adverb):
Meaning: without doubt (used for emphasis).
Example: I shall definitely be at the airport to meet you
Source: Oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com

English Language.question: ১২) Choose the correct one:
English Language.exp:
Acquaintance (noun):
Meaning: knowledge or experience of something.
Example: ''the pupils had little acquaintance with the language''
Source: oxfordlearnersdictinaries.com

English Language.question: ১৩) When a person says he will ‘face the music’, it means-
English Language.option2: খ) He will listen to songs.
English Language.option3: গ) He will sit and listen
English Language.option4: ঘ) He will try to comprehend
English Language.exp:
FACE THE MUSIC (PHRASE):
informal
Meaning: be confronted with the unpleasant consequences of one’s actions.
Source: Oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com

English Language.question: ১৪) 'Fill me in' means-
English Language.option4: ঘ) Give me a helping hand
English Language.exp:
Fill me in (phrase):
Meaning: To provide information or details
Source: Oxford Languages

English Language.question: ১৫) The last word of the proverb, ‘Absence makes the heart grow ____’
English Language.exp:
পুরো proverbটি হবে- ‘Absence makes the heart grow fonder.’
অর্থ: অনুপস্থিতি অন্তরের ভালোবাসা আরো বাড়িয়ে তোলে।

English Language.question: ১৬) The last word of the proverb, ‘A bird in hand is worth two in the ___.’
English Language.exp:
পুরো বাক্যটা হবে- A bird in hand is worth two in the bush.
Meaning: Things we already have are more valuable than what we hope to get.
Source: Oxford languages

English Language.question: ১৭) ‘You live and learn’ means-
English Language.option2: খ) To get surprised after knowing something
English Language.exp:
You live and learn
Meaning: It is said when you hear or discover something that is surprising:
I had no idea they were related. Oh well, you live and learn.
Source: Cambridge dictionary

English Language.question: ১৮) ‘It costs a fortune’ means-
English Language.exp:
It costs a fortune
Meaning: to cost a lot of money
EXAMPLE: It costs a fortune to get the car fixed.
Source: macmillan Dictionary

English Language.question: ১৯) Choose the correct one:
English Language.exp:
Guarantee (adjective):
Meaning: formal assurance (typically in writing) that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if not of a specified quality.
Example: ''we offer a 10-year guarantee against rusting''
Source: Oxford languages

English Language.question: ২০) Choose the correct sentence:
English Language.option1: ক) We all wanted having more English classes.
English Language.option2: খ) We all wanted to have more English classes.
English Language.option3: গ) We all wanted have more English classes.
English Language.option4: ঘ) We all wanted to be had have had more English classes.
English Language.exp:
নিম্নলিখিত verb-গুলোর পর আরেকটি verb- থাকলে তার সাথে to যোগ করতে হয়।
সেগুলো হলঃ choose, decide, expect, forget, hate, hope, intend, learn, like, love, mean, plan, prefer, remember, want, would like/love ইত্যাদি।
Source: English.britishcouncil.org

English Language.question: ২১) The plural form of the word 'Lion'?
English Language.exp:
Lion- এর plural form হয় Lions. কিছু শব্দের শেষে -s যোগ করতে হয় plural করার জন্য।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ২২) What is the singular form of 'criteria'?
English Language.exp:
এগুলোকে বলা হয় foreign plural। কিছু Foreign plural আছে যেগুলো নির্দিষ্ট কিছু ফর্ম গ্রহণ করে।
যেমনঃ agendum-agenda, basis-bases, Genus-genera , Criterion-Criteria ইত্যাদি।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ২৩) Identify the word which remains the same in its plural form:
English Language.exp:
aircraft, series, spacecraft, salmon, bison, deer ইত্যাদি noun-এর singular ও plural form একই হয়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ২৪) Which of the following words is in singular form?
English Language.exp:
Statistics দেখতে plural হলেও কিন্তু আসলে ব্যবহারের দিক দিয়ে singular।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ২৫) Which one takes apostrophe and ‘s’ to become plural?
English Language.exp:
বর্ণ, সংখ্যা, এবং প্রতীককে plural করতে হলে ’s বসাতে হয়।
Example: Dot your i’s and cut your t’s.
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ২৬) Which of the following words is in feminine form?
English Language.exp:
সৌন্দর্য ও মাধুর্য প্রকাশক বিষয়গুলি প্রায়শ feminine gender হয়।
যেমন- The Moon, The Earth, Nature এবং liberty ইত্যাদি।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ২৭) Which one is the common gender?
English Language.exp:
পুংবাচক বা স্ত্রীবাচক উভয়কে বোঝালে common gender হয়।
যেমন- friend শব্দটি দিয়ে বন্ধু এবং বান্ধবী- উভয়কেই বুঝায়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ২৮) Which one is neuter gender?
English Language.exp:
ইতর প্রাণীকে neuter gender হিসেবে গণ্য করা হয়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ২৯) Which one is gender neutral?
English Language.exp:
কিছু কিছু শব্দ থাকে পুরুষ ও নারী- উভয়ের জন্যই ব্যবহৃত হয়।
এখানে একমাত্র server শব্দটি নারী ও পুরুষ উভয়ের জন্যই ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Language.question: ৩০) Which one is in masculine gender?
English Language.exp:
উল্লেখযোগ্য শক্তি বা ক্ষমতার অধিকারী বিষয়গুলো প্রায়শ Masculine gender হয়।
যেমন: The sun, Summer, Winter, Death, Time ইত্যাদি।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৩১) The moon has hidden ____ face in the cloud.
English Language.exp:
ব্যাখ্যা: Moon feminine gender-এ হয়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৩২) The mouse cut the rope by ____ teeth.
English Language.exp:
ইতর প্রাণী neuter gender হয়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৩৩) The furniture in this house ____ to be replaced.
English Language.exp:
ব্যাখ্যা: সংখ্যার সাহায্যে গোণা যায় না এমন uncountable noun-এর পরে singular verb বসে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৩৪) The plural form for ‘fox’-
English Language.exp:
কিছু noun-এর শেষে -es যোগ করে plural করতে হয়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৩৫) The plural form for Dynamo-
English Language.exp:
Noun-এর শেষে o থাকলে -es যুক্ত হয়। কিন্তু কিছু ব্যতিক্রম হল Dynamo, Piano, Photo, Quarto ইত্যাদি।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৩৬) The plural form for ‘belief’ is-
English Language.exp:
কিছু কিছু noun- এর শেষে f থাকলেও s যোগ করে plural করতে হয়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৩৭) The plural form for ‘Human’ is-
English Language.exp:
কতকগুলো noun-eর ভেতরের vowel পরিবর্তন করে plural করতে হয়।
যেমন- man-men, Foot-feet. কিন্তু humanকে পরিবর্তন করতে হলে শেষে -s যোগ করতে হয়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৩৮) Which word does not have any plural form?
English Language.exp:
কতকগুলো noun শুধুমাত্র singular form-এই ব্যবহৃত হয়।
যেমন- alphabet, furniture, information, Poetry, Issue, scenery ইত্যাদি।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৩৯) The plural form for ‘Addendum’ is-
English Language.exp:
কিছু Foreign plural আছে যেগুলো নির্দিষ্ট কিছু ফর্ম গ্রহণ করে।
যেমনঃ agendum-agenda, basis-bases, Genus-genera , Addendum-Addenda ইত্যাদি।
Source: oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com and Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das

English Language.question: ৪০) Which one is always plural?
English Language.exp:
কিছু noun সর্বদাই plural হয়।
যেমন, Bellows, Scissors, Glasses.
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P C Das

English Language.question: ৪১) Which of the following noun has a different meaning in plural?
English Language.exp:
Physic শব্দটি singular হলে এর অর্থ হল ওষুধ, কিন্তু Physics অর্থ হল পদার্থবিদ্যা।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৪২) He is good ____ nothing.
English Language.exp:
দক্ষতা অর্থে good-এর পরে at বসে। কিন্তু এই বাক্যটির অর্থ হল সে কোন কাজের না। এখানে for হবে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৪৩) Do not easily jump ____ a conclusion.
English Language.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থঃ এত সহজে কোন সিদ্ধান্তে পৌঁছে যেও না।
সিদ্ধান্তে পৌঁছানো বুঝালে jump-এর পরে to বসে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৪৪) He will soon tide ____ the difficulty.
English Language.exp:
Tide over অর্থ অতিক্রম করা। অতিক্রম করা অর্থে tide এর পরে over হয়।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৪৫) His opinion varies ____ his brother.
English Language.exp:
আলাদা হওয়া অর্থে বুঝালে vary-এর পরে from বসে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition

English Language.question: ৪৬) Choose the correct spelling:
English Language.exp:
Independent (Noun):

Meaning: free from outside control; not subject to another's authority.
Example: I wanted to remain independent in old age.

Source: Oxford Languages

English Language.question: ৪৭) Choose the correct spelling:
English Language.exp:
Playwright (n):
Meaning: a person who writes plays.
Bengali Meaning: নাট্যকার
Source: Oxford Languages

English Language.question: ৪৮) Choose the correct spelling:
English Language.exp:
Personnel (noun):
Meaning: people employed in an organization or engaged in an organized undertaking such as military service.
Example: Many of the personnel involved require training

English Language.question: ৪৯) A cat has ____ lives.
English Language.exp:
পুরো proverbটি হবে A cat has nine lives.
Meaning: Cat can survive seemingly fatal events.
Example: I haven’t seen him for several weeks, but I wouldn’t really worry about him. Everyone knows a cat has nine lives.

English Language.question: ৫০) Choose the correct sentence:
English Language.option1: ক) The robbers fall with the passer-by.
English Language.option2: খ) The robbers fall at the passer-by.
English Language.option3: গ) The robbers fall on the passer-by.
English Language.option4: ঘ) The robbers fall over the passer-by.
English Language.exp:
Fall on অর্থ হল আক্রমণ করা। আক্রমণ করা অর্থে ব্যবহৃত হলে fall এর পরে on বসে।
Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P C Das
